description: A friendly 21-year-old Vietnamese young man speaking clear, natural standard American English. Warm, patient and encouraging, like a kind older brother teaching. Medium pitch, moderate pace, clean studio recording.
text: Hi everyone, I'm Tín. Welcome to YOLO7 English! Today we're at my mom's pho shop in Hẻm ninety-nine. Listen carefully: What would you like? Small or large? No onions, please. Now let's practice together. You've got seven seconds!
